project: ADR-062 — Capability Injection: Real Backends and Test-Harness-Only Nullifiers
description: Realization of ADR-062 (applying umbrella spec §17.17 unchanged). Every provider capability whose in-memory arm is a security nullifier (key custody, device attestation, pre-rotation custody, DID/DHT resolution, relay querier) gets a real production backend behind a dispatch seam, and its in-memory arm becomes a test-harness-only double (absent from shipped artifacts via G1's closed subset-allowlist); durability-only arms (storage, push, blob) stay legitimate explicit runtime options, never Default. The allow_in_memory_custody switch, the public custody=in_memory config, and the DidDht<D=InMemoryDhtClient> nullifier-default type parameter are all deleted. Units: UNIT 1 (Slice 0 module, Slice 1 DHT E1 incl. DidDht default removal + node DhtMode reconciliation) is executable now. UNIT 2 (pre-rotation on ACCEPTED ADR-054 + §9.7.4.1 item 3a: seam Slice 2, server floor Slice 3, interactive floor Slice 4, §5/§6 ceremony Slice 5; severance Slice 6; native SDK backends Swift/Kotlin Slices 7/8; Python/TS FIDO2 Slices 12/13). UNIT 3 (live SCP-CAPSEL fixes + completeness: E2 credentials Slice 9, E3 blob Slice 10, E4 relay-querier Slice 11 — the impl-Default removals are live violations, storied now). #1733 folds and closes at Slice 6. Every capability is classified per §17.17.2 in the ADR.

stories.title: Module structure: move in-memory storage/push to an honest in_memory/ module (durability-only, runtime-selectable), keep nullifier doubles testing-gated, delete `pub use testing as software`, delete BridgeInMemoryStorage, re-point the server-feature storage path (F1)
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 0 (Unit 1, foundational, §Decision 0). Split scp-platform's `pub mod testing` by truth: (a) move `InMemoryStorage`+`InMemoryPush` into `crates/scp-platform/src/in_memory/` behind `in-memory-storage`/`in-memory-push` features (in-memory-push pulls dep:uuid), compiled-available and selected explicitly via `StorageConfig` (never default/fallback, §17.17 SCP-CAPSEL-8000/8011 — the OpenMLS-MemoryStorage case); (b) leave the nullifier doubles (`InMemoryKeyCustody`, `InMemoryDeviceAttestation`, `InMemoryPreRotationCustody`) in the `testing`-named module behind `testing`; (c) delete `pub use testing as software` (lib.rs:52); (d) delete `BridgeInMemoryStorage` (struct + impl Storage + `BridgeInMemoryStorageHandle`:275 + `BridgeInMemoryRepo`:285 + the third tuple element of `build_event_log_provider`:315, the common/src/lib.rs re-export, the three bridge runtime.rs incl. scp-ffi/src/runtime.rs:1112, the uniffi/Cargo.toml:63 comment) — bridges use `EncryptingAdapter<scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage>` (the `EncryptingAdapter<S>` handle is generic). F1 storage half: re-point `scp-ffi-common`'s `server` feature `scp-platform/testing` edge (common/Cargo.toml:30) to `scp-platform/in-memory-storage`, and switch `server.rs`'s non-test STORAGE construction to the `in_memory` path (the custody phantoms server.rs:322/435 are Slice 6; the DHT constructor server.rs:455 is Slice 1). Does NOT delete the switch or demote nullifiers. Scope exception (prd.md): a module move + feature split + twin deletion is atomic — a half-applied move breaks the build.
acceptanceCriteria: InMemoryStorage and InMemoryPush live in an honest module: crates/scp-platform/src/in_memory/storage.rs and push.rs exist, `grep -rn 'pub use.*InMemoryStorage\|pub use.*InMemoryPush' crates/scp-platform/src/in_memory/mod.rs` matches, and `grep -rn 'InMemoryStorage\|InMemoryPush' crates/scp-platform/src/testing/mod.rs` returns 0.

Two durability-only features exist and gate the module: `grep -nE '^in-memory-(storage|push) *=' crates/scp-platform/Cargo.toml` shows both (in-memory-push pulls dep:uuid); each in_memory/ submodule + re-export carries `#[cfg(feature = "in-memory-<type>")]`; `cargo build -p scp-platform --no-default-features --features in-memory-storage` compiles InMemoryStorage WITHOUT enabling `testing`.
`pub use testing as software` is deleted: `grep -n 'testing as software' crates/scp-platform/src/lib.rs` returns 0.

The three nullifier doubles remain testing-gated: `grep -n 'InMemoryKeyCustody\|InMemoryDeviceAttestation\|InMemoryPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-platform/src/testing/mod.rs` shows all three behind the `#[cfg(feature = "testing")]` module gate.

BridgeInMemoryStorage is deleted: `grep -rn 'BridgeInMemoryStorage' crates/` returns 0; `build_event_log_provider` keeps its tuple shape backed by `EncryptingAdapter<scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage>`; the three bridge runtime.rs + common/src/lib.rs re-export + uniffi/Cargo.toml:63 are updated.

F1 storage half: `grep -n 'scp-platform/testing' crates/scp-ffi/common/Cargo.toml` returns 0 (the `server` feature pulls `scp-platform/in-memory-storage`), and non-test STORAGE construction in crates/scp-ffi/common/src/server.rs uses `scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage`.

In-memory storage remains an explicit durability-only runtime option: the bridge `StorageConfig` in-memory arm resolves to `scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage` and no code path defaults/falls back to it (SCP-CAPSEL-8000/8001).

Full CI green: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features scp-ffi-uniffi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-ffi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-ffi-napi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-core/testing,scp-runtime/testing -- -D warnings` (switch still exists this slice); `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(python3.12 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_config_var('LIBDIR'))") cargo test --workspace` — all exit 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with all stories present.
actionItems: git mv the storage/push adapters testing/ -> in_memory/; add `pub mod in_memory` gated on the two features; delete `pub use testing as software`.
Add in-memory-storage/in-memory-push (dep:uuid) features; keep `testing` gating the three nullifier modules.

Delete BridgeInMemoryStorage + aliases; back build_event_log_provider with EncryptingAdapter<scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage>; update the three runtime.rs + common/src/lib.rs + uniffi/Cargo.toml:63.
F1 storage half: re-point common/Cargo.toml server feature; switch server.rs non-test storage construction to in_memory.
Point the bridge StorageConfig in-memory arm at scp_platform::in_memory::InMemoryStorage; run full CI + review roster.

stories.title: DHT E1 (structural): remove the DidDht<D=InMemoryDhtClient> default type param + impl Default + new(); ship real Pkarr on PyO3/NAPI; node DhtMode::Memory -> test-harness-only + fail-closed DhtMode::Disabled; demote in-memory DHT to a test-harness double
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 1 (Unit 1, E1 HIGH; §Decision 1 + D-A + D-B) — builds on SCP-CAPINJECT-000. STRUCTURAL ROOT FIX (D-A): in crates/scp-identity/src/dht.rs, remove the `= InMemoryDhtClient` default type parameter -> `pub struct DidDht<D: DhtClient, C: Clock = SystemClock>` (Clock default stays; SystemClock is not a nullifier), and DELETE `impl Default for DidDht<InMemoryDhtClient>` (:264) + the `pub fn new()` constructor (:270) that hardcode `InMemoryDhtClient::new()`. Every caller now constructs with an explicit DhtClient — PkarrDhtClient on production paths, InMemoryDhtClient only in `#[cfg(test)]`/`testing` code — so no silent in-memory DHT default is expressible (SCP-CAPSEL-8002 by construction). Blast radius (all in files[]): scp-identity/src/{dht.rs,config.rs}+Cargo.toml; scp-node/src/{self_host.rs,lib.rs,config.rs}+Cargo.toml; scp-runtime/src/discovery/{dht_context.rs,did_capabilities.rs}+Cargo.toml; scp-testing/src/helpers.rs+Cargo.toml; scp-ffi/common/src/{server.rs,resolvers.rs,bridge_instance.rs}; scp-ffi/{src,napi/src}/identity.rs; uniffi/src/bridge.rs (:3912/:8063/:9010/:9130/:16714 etc.). Then: `production-dht` unconditional on scp-ffi/napi/common; shared `enum FfiDhtClient` (Pkarr compiled unconditionally + `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))] InMemory`); retype the chokepoints bridge_instance.rs:358 + server.rs:35 onto FfiDhtClient (the D-A removal compile-forces converting server.rs:455's `InMemoryDhtClient::new()` HERE, moved out of Slice 6); `ClientDhtConfig { gateways }` + `into_client -> Result<_, DhtInitError>` fail-closed; delete throwaway/fresh-per-call clients (scp-ffi/src/identity.rs, napi, uniffi make_dht_with_signer). D-B (node DhtMode reconciliation): `build_memory_did_method` builds DidDht<InMemoryDhtClient> used for BOTH publish and resolve, so DhtMode::Memory is a §17.17.3 resolve-nullifier -> make `DhtMode::Memory` test-harness-only (gated), add a new fail-closed `DhtMode::Disabled` (resolve returns a typed Err, never a silent in-memory no-op), and update construction.md M2's DhtMode::Memory-is-fail-safe text to name Disabled as the fail-safe no-publish value. scp-dht/testing wiring: gate InMemoryDhtClient's type behind a NEW `scp-dht/testing` feature; scp-dht stays a NORMAL dependency; each bridge/consumer `testing` feature carries `scp-dht/testing` as a NORMAL feature edge, and each consumer constructing InMemoryDhtClient in its own tests lists `scp-dht/testing` in ITS [dev-dependencies] (scp-node, scp-runtime, scp-testing) — `scp-dht/testing` MUST NOT appear in any default/non-testing feature list. Add matrix DHT rows. Closes #1518, re-satisfies #627, closes #1880. Scope exception: the default-removal + type-gate + chokepoint retype + node DhtMode split are atomic (partial application breaks the build).
acceptanceCriteria: The DidDht nullifier-default is removed (D-A): `grep -n 'DidDht<D: DhtClient = InMemoryDhtClient' crates/scp-identity/src/dht.rs` returns 0; `grep -n 'impl Default for DidDht<InMemoryDhtClient' crates/scp-identity/src/dht.rs` returns 0; and `grep -n 'pub fn new()' crates/scp-identity/src/dht.rs` returns 0 (the in-memory-hardcoding constructor is gone). The struct is `DidDht<D: DhtClient, C: Clock = SystemClock>`.

Every production caller constructs an explicit DhtClient; in-memory DHT appears only in test code: outside `#[cfg(test)]`/`#[cfg(feature = "testing")]`, `grep -rn 'InMemoryDhtClient' crates/scp-identity crates/scp-node crates/scp-runtime crates/scp-ffi` returns 0; the workspace compiles with the default-param removed (bare-production `cargo build --workspace` with no testing features succeeds and InMemoryDhtClient is out of scope).

production-dht unconditional on the three FFI crates: `grep -nE 'production-dht' crates/scp-ffi/Cargo.toml crates/scp-ffi/common/Cargo.toml crates/scp-ffi/napi/Cargo.toml` shows scp-dht pulled with production-dht in each dependency features list; no `[features]` entry makes it optional.

A shared `enum FfiDhtClient` (Pkarr unconditional + `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))] InMemory`): `grep -n 'pub enum FfiDhtClient' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/dht.rs` matches, the InMemory arm is immediately preceded by that cfg, `grep -n 'allow_in_memory' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/dht.rs` returns 0, `impl scp_dht::DhtClient for FfiDhtClient` delegates publish/resolve.

InMemoryDhtClient type-gated behind a new `scp-dht/testing` feature wired as NORMAL edges: `grep -n 'testing' crates/scp-dht/Cargo.toml` shows the feature; the `pub struct InMemoryDhtClient` + impls carry `#[cfg(feature = "testing")]`; `scp-dht/testing` appears in the bridge/consumer `testing` feature lists AND in the [dev-dependencies] of scp-node/scp-runtime/scp-testing; and `scp-dht/testing` appears in NO default/non-testing feature list (grep the Cargo.tomls to confirm it is only under `testing = [...]` or `[dev-dependencies]`).

Chokepoints retyped incl. server.rs:455: `grep -n 'type ConcreteDidMethod = DidDht<FfiDhtClient, SystemClock>' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/server.rs` and `grep -n 'dht_client: OnceLock<Arc<FfiDhtClient>>' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/bridge_instance.rs` both match; outside `#[cfg(test)]`, `grep -n 'InMemoryDhtClient::new()' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/server.rs` returns 0 (the :455 constructor converted here).

Throwaway/fresh-per-call clients deleted: outside `#[cfg(test)]`, `grep -nE 'InMemoryDhtClient::new\(\)' crates/scp-ffi/src/identity.rs crates/scp-ffi/napi/src/identity.rs` returns 0; the rotation_publish_client fallback and the uniffi make_dht_with_signer fresh-client are removed; an async test rotates a key and asserts a subsequent resolve through the shared resolver reflects the rotation.

Production DHT fails closed: `ClientDhtConfig::into_client` returns `Err(DhtInitError)` when Pkarr cannot be built; `grep -nE 'unwrap_or|or_else|InMemory' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/dht.rs` shows no in-memory/no-op substitution; a unit test asserts an unsatisfiable production config yields Err.

D-B node DhtMode reconciliation: `grep -n 'Disabled' crates/scp-node/src/config.rs` shows a new `DhtMode::Disabled` variant; `DhtMode::Memory` is gated `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))]`; a node built for production (no testing) that selects Disabled returns a typed Err on DID resolution (a test asserts this, not a silent None); and construction.md M2's `DhtMode::Memory`-is-fail-safe text is updated to name `Disabled` (grep .docs/standards/construction.md for `DhtMode::Disabled`).

.docs/standards/sdk-capability-matrix.json records DHT shipped backend = Pkarr per binding; `grep -c 'Pkarr' .docs/standards/sdk-capability-matrix.json` >= 1; `python3.12 scripts/check-sdk-coverage.py` exits 0.

Tests: an `#[ignore]`d live-Mainline roundtrip in crates/scp-ffi/common/tests/dht_capability_injection.rs, and a `#[cfg(not(feature = "testing"))]` compile assertion that FfiDhtClient resolves to Pkarr and InMemoryDhtClient is not in scope in a shipped build.

Full CI green: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features scp-ffi-uniffi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-ffi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-ffi-napi/allow_in_memory_custody,scp-core/testing,scp-runtime/testing -- -D warnings` (switch still exists this slice); a bare-production `cargo build --workspace` (no testing, no allow_in_memory_custody) — Pkarr-only graph compiles, InMemoryDhtClient type absent; `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(python3.12 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_config_var('LIBDIR'))") cargo test --workspace` — all exit 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with this story present.
actionItems: Remove the DidDht `= InMemoryDhtClient` default type param + delete `impl Default for DidDht<InMemoryDhtClient>` + `pub fn new()`; migrate every caller to an explicit DhtClient (Pkarr prod; InMemoryDhtClient under `#[cfg(test)]`/`testing`).

Add a `testing` feature to crates/scp-dht/Cargo.toml, `#[cfg(feature = "testing")]`-gate InMemoryDhtClient; keep scp-dht a NORMAL dep; carry `scp-dht/testing` in each bridge/consumer `testing` feature + the [dev-dependencies] of scp-node/scp-runtime/scp-testing; never in a default list.

Enable production-dht unconditionally on scp-ffi/napi/common; create crates/scp-ffi/common/src/dht.rs (FfiDhtClient + ClientDhtConfig + DhtInitError); retype ConcreteDidMethod + the dht_client slot + convert server.rs:455.
Delete throwaway clients (scp-ffi/src/identity.rs, napi, uniffi); route rotation/migration through the shared FfiDhtClient with cache invalidation.
D-B: gate DhtMode::Memory test-harness-only, add fail-closed DhtMode::Disabled (typed Err on resolve), reconcile build_memory_did_method callers, update construction.md M2.
Add matrix DHT rows; write the tests; run full CI + review roster; PR closing keywords #1518/#627/#1880.

details.slice: Slice 1 (DHT E1 + D-A default removal + D-B node DhtMode)
details.scopeException: default-removal + type-gate + chokepoint retype + node DhtMode split are atomic

stories.title: Pre-rotation seam: PreRotationCustodyProvider FFI callback interface + CallbackPreRotationCustody adapter + FfiPreRotationCustody enum (Callback + test InMemory only); retype the ~12 welded sites (bind with_custody -> Callback); delete the traits.rs default-in-production doc-comment; bridge-aliases + matrix row
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 2 (Unit 2, E5; §Decision 4) — builds on ACCEPTED ADR-054. The dispatch seam only (no KMS/offline backend yet). Per ADR-054 §1: add the `PreRotationCustodyProvider` FFI callback interface (UniFFI [Trait, WithForeign] + PyO3 Py<PyAny> + NAPI TSFN) with the four canonical methods generate/public_key/import_seed_bytes/consume (mapped to the existing core `PreRotationCustody` trait methods per ADR-054's locked table — the core trait at traits.rs:740 is NOT renamed), and a `CallbackPreRotationCustody` adapter implementing the core trait with the single-use handle invariant. Because PreRotationCustody is RPITIT (traits.rs:759/772/782) the seam is an `enum FfiPreRotationCustody` — but to avoid front-loaded stubs the enum in THIS slice has ONLY `Callback(CallbackPreRotationCustody)` + `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))] InMemory(InMemoryPreRotationCustody)` (the IndependentPrincipal arm lands with its KMS backend in Slice 3, EncryptedOffline with its backend in Slice 4). Retype ALL ~12 ungated concrete create-path sites onto FfiPreRotationCustody: scp-ffi/src/identity.rs:987, runtime.rs:1984; napi/src/identity.rs:1130, runtime.rs:1385, napi/src/scp.rs:456/587/729; uniffi/src/bridge.rs:2467/9016/9136/9219/16716/20825/22590. The TWO identity_create_with_custody sites (napi scp.rs, uniffi bridge.rs:9136) MUST bind to the `Callback` arm (caller-supplied custody backs pre-rotation too); a blanket 0-InMemory AC MUST NOT be satisfiable by routing with_custody through a fail-closed/EncryptedOffline path. Delete the traits.rs doc-comment claiming InMemoryPreRotationCustody is the production default (a §3a violation). Add bridge-aliases.json entries for the per-binding-cased callback methods (else check-bridge-symmetry.sh trips). Add the pre-rotation-provider row to sdk-capability-matrix.json. No production default selects InMemory (fail closed pending Slices 3-5). Scope exception: the provider interface + enum + retype are one FFI-surface change.
acceptanceCriteria: The core PreRotationCustody trait is unchanged: `grep -n 'trait PreRotationCustody' crates/scp-platform/src/traits.rs` matches with store_committed_pre_rotation_key / reveal_public_key / destroy_after_migration / custody_kind.

A `PreRotationCustodyProvider` FFI callback interface exists on all three bridges with the four canonical methods: `grep -rn 'PreRotationCustodyProvider' crates/scp-ffi/uniffi/src/bridge.rs crates/scp-ffi/src/identity.rs crates/scp-ffi/napi/src/identity.rs` matches; a `CallbackPreRotationCustody` adapter exists (`grep -rn 'CallbackPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-ffi/common/src`) with the single-use handle invalidated in Rust after consume (a test asserts a second consume/public_key returns HandleNotFound).

The seam is an enum with EXACTLY two arms this slice (no stubs): `grep -n 'enum FfiPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/pre_rotation.rs` matches with arms `Callback` and `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))] InMemory` and NO `IndependentPrincipal`/`EncryptedOffline` arms yet; `grep -n 'Arc<dyn PreRotationCustody>' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/pre_rotation.rs` returns 0.

All ~12 welded create-path sites are retyped onto FfiPreRotationCustody: `grep -rn 'Arc<scp_platform::testing::InMemoryPreRotationCustody>' crates/scp-ffi` returns 0 outside `#[cfg(test)]`/`#[cfg(feature="testing")]`; the field type is `FfiPreRotationCustody` at all 12 sites (grep the enumerated files).

The two identity_create_with_custody sites bind to the Callback arm: `grep -n 'FfiPreRotationCustody::Callback' crates/scp-ffi/napi/src/scp.rs crates/scp-ffi/uniffi/src/bridge.rs` matches at the with-custody paths (bridge.rs:~9136), and a test asserts caller-supplied custody also backs the pre-rotation key (not silently routed to EncryptedOffline/fail-closed).
The traits.rs `default in production ... until backends wired in` doc-comment is deleted: `grep -n 'default in production' crates/scp-platform/src/traits.rs` returns 0.

bridge-aliases.json carries the per-binding-cased pre-rotation callback method aliases and `bash scripts/check-bridge-symmetry.sh` exits 0; `.docs/standards/sdk-capability-matrix.json` has a pre-rotation-provider row and `python3.12 scripts/check-sdk-coverage.py` exits 0.

No production default selects InMemory: outside `#[cfg(any(test, feature="testing"))]`, `grep -rn 'InMemoryPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-ffi` returns 0; a create call on a build without the real backends fails closed rather than defaulting to InMemory (a test asserts Err).

Full CI green: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; the workspace clippy command; `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(python3.12 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_config_var('LIBDIR'))") cargo test --workspace` — all exit 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with this story present.
actionItems: Add the PreRotationCustodyProvider FFI interface + CallbackPreRotationCustody adapter (single-use handle invariant) dispatching into the existing core-trait methods per ADR-054's locked table.
Define `enum FfiPreRotationCustody` with Callback + `#[cfg] InMemory` ONLY in crates/scp-ffi/common/src/pre_rotation.rs; declare in common/src/lib.rs.
Retype the ~12 welded sites onto FfiPreRotationCustody; bind the 2 with_custody sites to Callback; delete the traits.rs default-in-production doc-comment.
Add bridge-aliases.json entries + the sdk-capability-matrix.json pre-rotation-provider row.
Run full CI (incl. check-bridge-symmetry.sh, check-sdk-coverage.py) + review roster.

details.slice: Slice 2 (pre-rotation seam; enum = Callback + test InMemory only)
details.scopeException: provider interface + enum + retype are one FFI-surface change

stories.title: Pre-rotation server floor: KmsPreRotationCustody independent-principal backend (§3a(a)) + add the IndependentPrincipal enum arm; server-profile creation fails closed with no substrate; conformance PAIR (negative-reachability AND principal-distinctness); zeroize derived key
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 3 (Unit 2; §Decision 4, ADR-054 OQ2 §3a(a)) — builds on the seam (SCP-CAPINJECT-002). Ship the non-interactive-server floor: `KmsPreRotationCustody`, an independent-principal KMS/HSM/cloud-vault backend implementing the core PreRotationCustody trait, where the recovery authority resides under a principal DISTINCT from the operational-custody principal and the operational principal holds no read/use/decrypt/assume/delegate grant over it or any KEK/role in its wrapping/derivation chain (§9.7.4.1 item 3a(a)). ADD the `IndependentPrincipal(KmsPreRotationCustody)` arm to `FfiPreRotationCustody` in THIS slice (with its backend, no stub) and make it the server-profile default. No configured independent-principal substrate => server-profile creation fails closed (§3a(a)). Conformance = the ADR-054 PAIR — BOTH: (1) negative-reachability adversary test (harness gets the full operational surface + transitive wrapping links + published ciphertext, cannot reconstruct the 32-byte seed); AND (2) principal-distinctness structural assertion (the recovery-authority residence-id is distinct from the operational principal, and the operational grant set excludes read/use/decrypt/assume/delegate over EVERY secret/KEK/role in the derivation chain, not just the terminal KEK). Zeroize the derived AES/KEK key, not just seed bytes. Scope exception: backend + enum arm + fail-closed wiring + conformance PAIR are one substrate change.
acceptanceCriteria: `KmsPreRotationCustody` exists implementing the core trait: `grep -rn 'struct KmsPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/kms.rs` and `grep -rn 'impl PreRotationCustody for KmsPreRotationCustody' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/kms.rs` both match.

The IndependentPrincipal enum arm is added this slice: `grep -n 'IndependentPrincipal' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/pre_rotation.rs` matches, and it is the server-profile default (grep the server-profile construction path).

Server-profile creation fails closed with no configured substrate (§3a(a)): a test asserts server-profile identity creation returns a typed Err (no fallback to InMemory/co-located) when no KMS/HSM substrate is configured.

Conformance PAIR part 1 (negative-reachability): a test in crates/scp-testing/tests/integration/pre_rotation_residence.rs hands the harness the full operational surface + transitive wrapping links + published ciphertext and asserts it CANNOT reconstruct the 32-byte seed.

Conformance PAIR part 2 (principal-distinctness): the same test file asserts the recovery-authority residence-id is DISTINCT from the operational principal AND the operational grant set excludes read/use/decrypt/assume/delegate over every secret/KEK/role in the derivation chain (grep the test for `residence_id`/`assume`/`delegate`/`distinct`); BOTH parts MUST pass.
Derived key material is zeroized: `grep -rn 'Zeroizing\|zeroize' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/kms.rs` shows the derived KEK/AES key (not only the seed) held in zeroizing memory.

Full CI green: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; the workspace clippy command; `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(python3.12 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_config_var('LIBDIR'))") cargo test --workspace` — all exit 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with this story present.

stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 4 (Unit 2; §Decision 4, ADR-054 §2 + OQ2 §3a(b)) — builds on the seam (SCP-CAPINJECT-002). Ship the interactive-client floor + shared codecs: (a) `EncryptedOfflinePreRotationCustody` (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id memory=64 MiB/iter=3/parallelism=4) whose passphrase is USER-SUPPLIED per-recovery and never persisted server-reachably (§3a(b)); the SDK MUST enforce a minimum-strength check requiring >=128 bits of guessing entropy against the published Argon2id params using a real estimator (zxcvbn-class with a guess-count threshold equivalent to >= 2^128 offline guesses given the Argon2id cost), NOT a length heuristic, and reject low-entropy inputs; (b) Shamir 3-of-5 over GF(2^8) and BIP39 24-word pure codecs. ADD the `EncryptedOffline(EncryptedOfflinePreRotationCustody)` arm to FfiPreRotationCustody in THIS slice (with its backend). The SDK MUST NOT offer auto-generated-passphrase encrypted-offline as a server-profile standalone floor (ADR-054 per-backend §3-soundness). Zeroize the derived AES key AND the passphrase-derived material. Conformance = the ADR-054 PAIR for the encrypted-offline case: part 1 negative-reachability (user-supplied passphrase absent from operational stores => seed not reconstructable from operational surface + published ciphertext), part 2 principal-distinctness AND a co-located-passphrase variant MUST FAIL the test by construction; for Shamir, part 2 asserts fewer than 3 shares are operationally reachable. Scope exception: interactive backend + codecs + enum arm + conformance PAIR are one cryptographic unit.
acceptanceCriteria: `EncryptedOfflinePreRotationCustody` exists with the exact Argon2id parameters: `grep -rnE 'Argon2|65536|Aes256Gcm' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/encrypted_offline.rs` matches memory=64MiB(65536)/iter=3/parallelism=4 + AES-256-GCM; it impls the core trait; a roundtrip test passes.

The min-strength check requires >=128-bit guessing entropy via a real estimator: `grep -rnE '128|zxcvbn|guess|entropy' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/encrypted_offline.rs` matches a guess-count/entropy threshold (not a length check), and a unit test asserts a low-entropy passphrase is rejected with a typed Err while a strong one is accepted.
Shamir 3-of-5 and BIP39 pure codecs exist: roundtrip tests pass (3-of-5 reconstructs; any 2 shares do NOT; BIP39 encode->decode is identity).

The EncryptedOffline enum arm is added this slice and excluded from the server-profile standalone floor: `grep -n 'EncryptedOffline' crates/scp-ffi/common/src/pre_rotation.rs` matches, and a test asserts the server-profile menu excludes auto-generated-passphrase encrypted-offline.

Derived key + passphrase material zeroized: `grep -rn 'Zeroizing\|zeroize' crates/scp-platform/src/pre_rotation/encrypted_offline.rs` shows both the derived AES key and passphrase-derived buffers are zeroizing.

Conformance PAIR covers encrypted-offline: the test asserts (part 1) a user-supplied passphrase absent from operational stores => seed not reconstructable, (part 2) a co-located-passphrase variant FAILS the test, and (Shamir) fewer than 3 shares operationally reachable (grep the test for all three).

Implement Shamir 3-of-5 (GF(2^8)) + BIP39 24-word pure codecs.

acceptanceCriteria: `allow_in_memory_custody` is deleted everywhere: `grep -rn 'allow_in_memory_custody' --include='*.toml' --include='*.rs' --include='*.yml' crates/ .github/` returns 0; `grep -n 'allow_in_memory_custody' CLAUDE.md TESTING.md CONTRIBUTING.md` returns 0; and `grep -c 'allow_in_memory_custody' .docs/standards/sdk-capability-matrix.json` returns 0 (the 4 stale device-attest strings fixed).

stories.title: E4 relay querier: implement the real MultiRelayQuerier per §3.10.12 (the relay-resolution layer), demote NoOpRelayQuerier/InMemoryRelayQuerier to test-harness-only
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 11 (Unit 3, E4 MED; §Decision 5, spec §3.10.12). `NoOpRelayQuerier` (resolver.rs:309) is the shipped relay-resolution arm; it is classified a NULLIFIER of the §3.10.8 dual-layer suppression resilience (DHT-only resolution is correct per the §3.10.6 SHOULD, but removing the relay layer weakens the both-layers suppression defense and it fails OPEN — silently contributes no relay result). Remediation = implement the REAL `MultiRelayQuerier` (the relay-resolution layer that queries the identity's relays per §3.10.4/§3.10.12) so resolution uses BOTH layers per §3.10.6, and demote `NoOpRelayQuerier` + the test `InMemoryRelayQuerier` (resolver.rs:910) to test-harness-only. This is a genuine code-behind-spec completeness gap (§3.10.12 is a Phase-2 deliverable). blockedBy [] (independent of the DHT client/pre-rotation work — this is the relay-query layer, not the DHT client). Scope exception: the real querier + resolver wiring + NoOp demotion are one resolution-layer change.
acceptanceCriteria: A real `MultiRelayQuerier` implementation exists that queries the identity's relays (§3.10.4/§3.10.12): `grep -rn 'impl MultiRelayQuerier for' crates/scp-identity/src/relay_querier.rs` matches a real (non-NoOp, non-InMemory) querier that performs relay QUERY, and the resolver composes both the relay layer and the DHT layer (grep the resolver's dual-layer path).

NoOpRelayQuerier + InMemoryRelayQuerier are test-harness-only: outside `#[cfg(test)]`/`#[cfg(feature = "testing")]`, `grep -rn 'NoOpRelayQuerier\|InMemoryRelayQuerier' crates/scp-identity/src` returns 0 references as the SHIPPED resolver arm (they may exist as test doubles gated by test/testing).

Dual-layer resolution is exercised: a test resolves a DID published to a relay (not the DHT) and asserts the relay layer returns it (proving relay-resolution is live, not NoOp), and a test asserts suppression on one layer is defeated by the other (§3.10.8).

Full CI green: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; the workspace clippy command; `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(python3.12 -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_config_var('LIBDIR'))") cargo test --workspace` — all exit 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with this story present.
actionItems: Implement a real MultiRelayQuerier (relay QUERY per §3.10.4/§3.10.12); wire it into the resolver's dual-layer resolution.
Demote NoOpRelayQuerier + InMemoryRelayQuerier to test-harness-only (test/testing-gated).
Write the dual-layer resolution + suppression-resilience tests; run full CI + review roster.

stories.title: Python FIDO2 pre-rotation backend: implement PreRotationCustodyProvider against USB FIDO2/CTAP2 on the desktop interactive profile and register it into the §5 menu
stories.description: ADR-062 Slice 12 (Unit 2b, D-C; ADR-054 §2). FIDO2/CTAP2 over a USB security key is reachable from desktop Python (the `fido2` library) on the INTERACTIVE-CLIENT profile (a CLI with a present human + USB key). Per §5's present-all-conforming-backends MUST, a Python interactive CLI where a USB FIDO2 key is reachable MUST offer it (§4 ranks FIDO2 Highest). Implement the Python `PreRotationCustodyProvider` (the FFI callback interface from Slice 2) against USB FIDO2/CTAP2 and register it into the §5 interactive-profile menu. This is the honest per-SDK scope decision (ADR §Residual #3): FIDO2 on the desktop interactive Python profile; a HEADLESS Python server uses the KMS floor (Slice 3), not FIDO2. P0 (same present-all-conforming rationale as Slices 7/8). Hardware-in-the-loop paths may be device-gated/skipped; the provider wiring, menu registration, and a software-simulated-authenticator unit test are the machine-verifiable core.
acceptanceCriteria: A Python FIDO2 provider implements the PreRotationCustodyProvider interface: `grep -rn 'class Fido2Provider\|generate\|public_key\|import_seed_bytes\|consume' bindings/python/scp_sdk/prerotation/fido2_provider.py` shows the four methods against the generated provider interface (using the `fido2`/CTAP2 library).

It is registered into the §5 interactive-profile menu for desktop Python: `grep -rn 'Fido2\|fido2' bindings/python/scp_sdk/prerotation/profile_menu.py` matches, and a test asserts the interactive-profile menu includes FIDO2 (ordered by security) while a simulated headless-server profile does NOT offer it (uses KMS).

A unit test exercises the provider against a software-simulated CTAP2 authenticator (generate -> public_key -> consume with the single-use handle invariant), hardware paths skipped when no key is present; `python3.12 -m pytest bindings/python/tests/test_prerotation_fido2.py -v` passes.
The Python SDK lint/type checks pass: `python3.12 -m ruff check bindings/python` exits 0.
`python3.12 scripts/validate-prd.py` exits 0 with this story present.
actionItems: Implement the Python Fido2Provider (USB FIDO2/CTAP2 via the `fido2` lib) against the generated PreRotationCustodyProvider interface.
Register it into the §5 interactive-profile menu; ensure a headless-server profile offers KMS not FIDO2.
Write test_prerotation_fido2.py (software-simulated authenticator + hardware-skip); run ruff + pytest + review roster.
